mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of the instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where HOUST increases > 5%, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4%, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where both conditions are met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE changes on 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals increased supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where INDPRO increases > 1%, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) growth rate above 3% over the past two months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of the instances where RSAFS growth is above 3%, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% annualized, it signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with low interest rates
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where both conditions are met, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
